snippet.title: Skybreaker: Rebuild Protocol - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Skybreaker: Rebuild Protocol is a chaotic 2D sandbox destruction game where you unleash disasters from the sky while tiny stick figure cities try to survive, react, rebuild, and recover.

Summon meteors, lightning, fire, tornadoes, bombs, vines, fireworks, demolition charges, and more as cities collapse piece by piece in a reactive world full of destruction, panic, rebuilding, and chain reactions.

This trailer shows the game in a much bigger state than the original early showcase, with more tools, more worlds, more reactions, stronger destruction effects, and a growing sandbox full of chaotic possibilities.

Features shown in this trailer:

* Meteor strikes, explosions, smoke, craters, and debris
* Lightning, Static Storm effects, fire, and chain reactions
* Tornadoes, bombs, demolition charges, and destructive tools
* Dynamic building collapse and rebuilding
* Stick figure survivors, families, firefighters, and rebuilders
* Future City robots, drones, and defenses
* Multiple worlds with different styles and reactions
* Sandbox gameplay focused on experimentation, chaos, and destruction

Skybreaker: Rebuild Protocol is my first game, built step by step alongside a full-time job. The game is still evolving, and every update brings new tools, systems, polish, and ideas into the sandbox.

If you enjoy destruction sandboxes, physics-driven chaos, emergent simulation, and watching a game grow over time, I would love to have you along for the journey.

Wishlist / Play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4434730/Skybreaker_Rebuild_Protocol/

Follow development, share feedback, and let me know what kind of destruction you want to see next.
